title: Which club will sign Nicolas Jackson on a permanent transfer from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window?
background: Nicolas Jackson is a Senegal international striker who joined Chelsea in 2023.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement by the buying or selling club, or reliable news reporting confirming a completed permanent transfer. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the club that completes Jackson's permanent signing from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window. Loan arrangements, reported interest, negotiations, and agreements that remain uncompleted do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The club's commonly used name.
